scope.scope: All condition coarse-Gold coverage losses in A-to-C and B-to-D; fine-Gold provenance cross-check of existing 52 recoveries. Not all other-field changes.

counting_rules.comparison_unit: direction x sample_id; repeats across directions are not independent samples
counting_rules.coarse_gold: one hull per field: min(start), max(end); gaps included
counting_rules.coarse_match: independent any nonempty same-field character intersection
counting_rules.new_prediction: (start,end,source text) absent from baseline constraint predictions; IDs and normalization ignored
counting_rules.fine_diagnostic: Read-only annotation evidence, not a new official evaluator. An exact fine span proves one annotated span was recovered, not all constraints or the whole record.
counting_rules.semantic_categories: AI case-by-case descriptions tied to fixed Gold; not proof of which instruction caused the change
